methodology.selection: Manual description-led selection, followed by deterministic quality gates; non-selected candidates retain unresolved status. Not a bulk inventory import or claim that every raw inventory row has received equal depth of editorial review.
screening: Existing canonical IDs, source URLs, normalized names and component names
Precise source points only; missing coordinates, invalid DMS and whole-minute-only pairs withheld
Near-existing coordinate collisions within 20 metres withheld
Protected point-in-polygon administrative context checked; no geometry edits or point movement
Description-location and alias/ensemble contradictions manually withheld
No current visitation/access claims inferred from historical catalogue descriptions
No UNESCO status inferred from local conservation awards; no new imagery
